title: PCTE Filter Staining Protocol
author: Ken Stedman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.eavbae6

steps.title: Stain PCTE filter with Sudan black B
steps.instruction: Apply Sudan black B solution to the filter under vacuum and dry the filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 4 µg/mL Sudan black B solution to the funnel.
Apply a vacuum of –70 kPa to draw the solution through the 30 nm pore PCTE filter (flow rate ≈0.1 mL/min) using a 25 mm diameter funnel.
Continue suction at –70 kPa until the filter appears dry.
